{{Quote|Under the circumstances, I respectfully recommend that you exercise your rights under the Captain's Authority directives and find out exactly who and what Odo is. At the very least, we should take another look at his authorization to be aboard this ship.|Commander Gilad Pellaeon, to Captain Calo Drusan|<ref name="Choices">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref>}}
The '''Captain's Authority''' was a series of directives that included a series of rights that a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] could exercise.<ref name="Choices" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> [[Imperial Court/Legends|Imperial Court]] member [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Nuso Esva|Odo]], who was secretly the [[Storm-hair|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] Nuso Esva, infiltrated the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']], covering [[Gender/Legends|his]] entire body to remain unidentified. The [[Warship/Legends|warship's]] [[third bridge officer]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], advised his [[Commanding officer/Legends|superior]], Captain [[Calo Drusan]], to use his Captain's Authority rights to learn the true identity of Odo. However, Drusan did not, telling Pellaeon that the Imperial lord had been verified by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] himself.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain's Authority was mentioned in ''[[Choices of One]]'', a [[2011]] novel written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Choices" />
